title: Coach Josh Boxing
description: High-conversion marketing site and member acquisition funnel for a Hamden, CT boxing gym. Deployed on Vercel. Built with Next.js, featuring GymDesk API sync, automated trial signups, and local SEO.
longDescription:
Developed the complete web presence and customer acquisition system for Coach Josh Boxing in Hamden, CT. Deployed to Vercel and built with the Next.js App Router for optimal performance.

Key features and integrations implemented:
• GymDesk Integration: Seamlessly synchronized the GymDesk booking API with custom client-side scheduling widgets, establishing a frictionless free trial signup flow for kids, teens, adults, and women's programs.
• Stripe Checkout: Wired secure payment gateways supporting membership tiers ($100–$175/mo) and private coaching booking.
• Automated Outreach: Integrated webhook triggers linking signups to automated SMS notifications and targeted email nurture sequences.
• SEO & Local search: Crafted local search and GEO schema optimization, positioning the site at the top of organic New Haven area search queries, helping drive gym capacity past 200 active athletes.

title: Coach Josh Official
description: Premium eCommerce and subscription portal for a content brand with 150M+ views. Deployed on Vercel. Built with Next.js, Mux Video SDK, Stripe Checkout, and offline PWA capability.
longDescription:
Engineered the direct-to-consumer digital product platform supporting Coach Josh's global digital brand (150M+ views across social platforms).

Key features and architecture implemented:
• PWA Wrapper: Configured service workers and web app manifests for a full Progressive Web App installation, letting users install the platform directly on their iOS/Android home screens for offline-first reading.
• Interactive eBook Engine: Crafted an Apple HIG-compliant digital reader for the 'Striking Blueprint' digital book, incorporating progress tracking and visual cues.
• Mux Video Integration: Implemented secure adaptive-bitrate video streaming via Mux with custom video players, offering secure access to the Premium Video Course.
• Stripe Subscriptions: Configured Stripe billing portals for managing private coaching subscriptions ($497/mo) and single sessions ($100).
• Community Gateway: Created automated Discord onboarding systems, helping build the free community channel to 400+ members.

title: BoxingWiki
description: Interactive technique library and learning portal for fight training. Deployed on Vercel. Built with React, featuring an interactive SVG muscle map, automated workout generator, and gamified retention mechanics.
longDescription:
Conceived, built, and deployed BoxingWiki to fill the void of specialized interactive fighting resources. Built using React, TypeScript, and Vite, and deployed to Vercel.

Key features and gamification loops implemented:
• Gamified Engagement (Octalysis Framework): Designed the core user loop based on Yu-kai Chou's gamification model. Leveraged Core Drive 2 (Development & Accomplishment) via custom daily streaks, and Core Drive 4 (Ownership & Possession) through customized, persistent favorites lists to drive consistent daily training behavior.
• Clickable Muscle Map: Created a responsive SVG interactive human map matching specific muscle regions to the 60+ techniques that utilize them.
• Heavy Bag Generator: Built a customizable boxing round timer and combination generator with text-to-speech voice cues.
• Stance Mirroring: Implemented a Southpaw mode that dynamically swaps image orientations and instructions for left-handed fighters.
• SEO Optimization: Built index-ready static layouts with rich structured JSON-LD schemas for all 60+ technique pages.

title: Sachi's Booty Builder
description: Mobile-first workout tracker and exercise guide. Deployed on Vercel. Built with React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS, featuring PWA home-screen installation and offline logs.
longDescription:
Designed and deployed a specialized, mobile-first training utility for 'Sachi's Booty Builder' to enable high-quality workout logging on the gym floor. Deployed to Vercel.

Key features and technical architecture implemented:
• PWA Capabilities: Developed service worker integrations and Add to Home Screen (A2HS) prompts for full application installation, offering a fast, standalone application interface.
• Local Storage Synchronization: Created a custom React state manager syncing directly with localStorage to persist weight logs, progression graphs, and set-completion streaks offline.
• Interactive Exercise Guide: Constructed a responsive database of target movements with auto-looping instructional video demonstrations and setup checklist panels.
• Responsive Brutalist Layout: Applied a high-contrast, touch-optimized visual layout leveraging CSS variables for smooth light/dark switching and high-density legibility.

title: Enterprise Video Solutions
description: Custom frontend video engineering and integrations at JW Player. Managed player architecture, VAST/VPAID ad systems, and DRM playback for major broadcasters.
longDescription:
Lead technical implementations and custom video integrations for JW Player's top-tier accounts, managing a $4M+ book of business including NBC, NPR, Forbes, TMZ, Hedgeye, and and The Weather Channel.

Key implementations and contributions:
• Ad Tech Integrations: Custom-coded ad systems deploying VAST/VPAID standards with Google IMA and FreeWheel SDKs, maximizing client ad-delivery rates.
• DRM & Security: Configured secure playback flows utilizing Widevine, FairPlay, and PlayReady DRM across web, mobile, and connected TV (CTV) platforms.
• Player Performance: Maintained the core player architecture, solving runtime errors on legacy browsers and TV platforms.
• Developer Mentorship: Built internal support wikis, standardized technical playbooks, and led training programs to elevate team support capabilities.

title: Players Club Community
description: Discord community hub for the Coach Josh content brand, scaling past 400 athletes. Engineered moderation layers, automated onboarding workflows, and integrated custom LLM agents to provide real-time form checks and technique reviews.
longDescription:
Designed, launched, and managed the entire digital community infrastructure for the Coach Josh brand, serving as the central hub converting organic traffic into paid product signups.

Key components and integrations implemented:
• Custom AI Agent Form Checks: Engineered a Node.js Discord bot integrated with vision LLMs. When users upload sparring or heavy bag videos, the agent critiques boxing guard, alignment, and movement patterns based on Blueprints rules.
• Automated Verification & Moderation: Configured custom AutoMod rules, regex patterns to block spam/malicious links, and verification gates (using Carl-bot and custom reaction roles) to secure the channel.
• Engagement Funnels: Designed and organized category channels covering technique feedback, combat analysis, and accountability check-ins.
• Live Event Broadcasting: Ran technology coordination for weekly live voice Q&As and fight review events, scaling the channel past 400 active members.

title: Project Negus
description: Cultural exhibition and panel production exploring African diaspora themes through multi-medium showcases and events at Yale.
longDescription:
Co-founded and produced a multi-faceted cultural project at Yale University, showcasing histories and artwork of the African diaspora.

Key contributions and production details:
• Art & Design Direction: Handled visual curation, poster design, and identity guidelines for multiple regional event rollouts.
• Multi-Medium Event Production: Organized panel discussions (focusing on cultural releases like Childish Gambino's 'Awaken My Love!'), collaborative fine art galleries, and film screenings.
• Community Engagement: Coordinated outreach across diverse local student organizations and Hamden community networks to establish shared cultural events.
